question: With reference to the early Indian history, who among the following was famous in the field of medicine?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Charaka.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Charaka was the court physician of Kaniska. 
 
• Charaka was one of the principal contributors to **Ayurveda medicine in ancient India.**
 
• He is best known for his work **Charaka Samhita.**
